description: This Java class 'SecurityValidationConfig' is a Spring configuration component that validates security authentication settings related to basic authentication and OAuth2. It ensures that at least one authentication method is enabled and that both are not enabled simultaneously, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: SecurityValidationConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that performs validation logic after the bean is initialized, ensuring proper security configuration regarding authentication methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: PostConstruct method that checks whether the security authentication configuration is consistent, throwing exceptions if no scheme is selected or if both schemes are enabled simultaneously.
